title: Townsend Brown fired by the Navy, moves to Martin Vega before Skunk Works

tellings.quote:
but in 1942 the Navy fires him without
cause and mysteriously he shows up at
Martin Vega Corporation a year before
skunkworks is formed

plain: In 1942 the Navy fired the researcher Thomas Townsend Brown without cause, and he then turned up at the Martin Vega Corporation, an aircraft maker, a year before Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design shop, was formed. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and calls the move mysterious. To him it suggests Brown's work quietly moved into the world of secret aircraft.
